anomalies.observed: TPS62933 pin 2 (EN) is marked no-connect in the schematic.
anomalies.expected: The buck enable should be driven to an asserted level or otherwise configured to enable the regulator. The specification says U2 converts +24 V to +5 V for the ESP32 DevKit and downstream LDO.

evidence.quote: U2 TPS62933 pin 2 EN has a no-connect marker (sheet 1/1, page 1).

anomalies.impact: With EN left unconnected, the regulator is not reliably enabled and will normally remain disabled due to its internal pull-down. The +5 V rail may therefore be absent, preventing the ESP32 and downstream circuitry from operating.

anomalies.observed: The schematic shows a LiDAR interface (PR7) wired through P2: VCC to +5 V, SDA and SCL to the I2C nets, and GND to ground.
anomalies.expected: The specification says the TF-Luna LiDAR is not wired into the design: its pins are free and it is not connected to any net.

evidence.quote: PR7 LiDAR; P2 pins connect VCC, SDA, SCL, and GND (sheet 1/1, page 1).
all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design (sheet 1, §4.3).

anomalies.impact: The design provides a powered, connected LiDAR interface that the specified design does not. Connecting a LiDAR would add a device to the I2C bus and could affect bus loading or behavior.

parsed.summary: The TPS62933 enable is explicitly left unconnected, likely preventing generation of the +5 V rail required by the controller. The drawing also wires a LiDAR interface to power and I2C despite the specification describing the LiDAR as unwired.
